summary: A complete, well-organised Stage 4 surface with an honest fallback declaration and a genuinely working program system, built on an audio engine that does not do what the panel says. Organ and Synth are the piano voice relabelled: every note renders the same two-oscillator subgraph, 14 synth waveforms collapse to 4 timbres (Sine vs Square specDist 1.55 against a 2.21 noise floor), the nine drawbars are inert (all-0 vs all-8 specDist 0.97), and the synth filter, LFO, envelopes and arpeggiator never reach audio. Neither engine can sound at all unless the same-letter piano layer is enabled (rms 8.3e-5 vs 0.093). Worse, every note-on rebuilds both layer racks and disconnects the sounding voices, so the instrument cannot play a chord: holding C3+A3+C4 leaves the C3 fundamental at -103 dB. Every panel click closes the AudioContext, losing the next note. Geometry, colour and key counts are excellent (aspect 3.0950 vs 3.0951, deck 0.5400, 5/5 reference colours), but the white keys cannot shrink to fit and five run off the chassis. Programs, splits, scenes, transpose and Panic are the strongest part and measurably work.

criteria.label: Distinct engine character
evidence: Organ and Synth are the piano voice relabelled: with a recording tap on AudioNode.prototype.connect, every note produces exactly the same subgraph (2 OscillatorNode -> BiquadFilterNode -> GainNode -> layer input; createOscillator rose by 2 per note-on). No organ-, drawbar- or synth-specific node type ever appears.

Fourteen synth waveforms collapse to four timbres. Measured mean per-bin spectral distance (repeat-measurement noise floor 2.21): Sine vs Square 1.55 and Square vs White Noise 2.27 - indistinguishable; only Sine vs Super Saw 5.54 and Super Saw vs FM 6.81 differ. 'White Noise' renders a pitched tone, not noise.

Organ models do differ (B3 vs Vox specDist 12.6, Vox vs Farf 14.0, Farf vs Pipe 13.6) but only because each model is mapped onto a different piano oscillator shape; no tonewheel, transistor or pipe behaviour, and the nine drawbars are inert (all-0 vs all-8 specDist 0.97, rms ratio 0.96).
Phase 3 hard gate 'B3, Vox, Farf and Pipe organ engines and the required Synth source categories are audibly distinct, not renamed copies of one oscillator' is not met.

criteria.label: Effects & routing integration
evidence: The single-context part is right: one AudioContext, per-layer input/effects/output racks, master gain -> DynamicsCompressor limiter -> one AudioDestinationNode (exactly one GainNode->DynamicsCompressorNode->AudioDestinationNode edge in the census), and every engine feeds a layer bus.

Organ and Synth are gated by the piano layer's enable flag: with Organ A on and Piano A off the rendered rms is 8.3e-5 versus 0.093 with Piano A on (-61 dB, inaudible). Same for Synth A (6.1e-5). Neither engine can be played on its own.

The Rotary unit is not in the graph at all: 34 StereoPannerNodes were created and the connect census contains zero edges to or from a StereoPannerNode. Toggling ROTARY changes nothing (specDist 0.751, rms ratio 1.0095).

Delay and Reverb are permanently in the path with a parallel dry leg, so their ON buttons are inert: DELAY on/off specDist 1.038, REVERB on/off specDist 1.055 - both below the 2.21 noise floor (the reverb AMOUNT slider does work, 0 vs 100 specDist 3.15).

Every note-on rebuilds both layer racks: after six notes the page had created 153 GainNodes, 84 BiquadFilterNodes, 34 DelayNodes, 34 ConvolverNodes, 34 StereoPannerNodes and 35 DynamicsCompressorNodes (18/9/4/4/4/5 after the first note). The old racks are disconnected and leaked.

criteria.label: Musical quality under load
evidence: The instrument is effectively monophonic. Holding C3+A3+C4 together, the C3 fundamental measures -103.4 dB in the 130.8 Hz bin, against -37.7 dB when C3 is played alone and -103.9 dB when it is not played at all; only the last note (261.6 Hz, -38.0 dB) survives. Chord rms 0.0736 vs single-note rms 0.0720.
Eight keys held simultaneously give rms 0.0564 and peak 0.185 - the same as one note (0.054 / 0.201). There is no polyphony to load, and therefore no clipping.
Latency and CPU are fine: keydown-to-return cost measured 1.4-1.9 ms over five note-ons and the PerformanceObserver recorded zero longtask entries during a six-note pass.

The first note after any panel interaction is lost: rms exactly 0.000000 over a 400 ms held note with context.currentTime still at 0.0053 s, because the previous AudioContext was closed and the replacement had not started.

criteria.label: Program & state round-trip
evidence: Store/recall works for the state it covers: edited Piano A level to 21 and TIMBRE to Soft, stored to slot 1.4, navigated to 1.1 and back - level 21 and TIMBRE Soft returned and the OLED went from '1.4 Vox Combo · E / Edited' to '1.4 Vox Combo / Stored program'. Discard-on-change also works (edited level 77, switched away and back, got the stored 21).

The program record is incomplete: organ drawbars, percussion, key click, vibrato and rotary speed/drive are module state outside the snapshot. Moving Organ drawbar 1 from 0 to 8 leaves the OLED reading 'Stored program' with no '· E' - the dirty indicator is untruthful for organ edits, and those values are neither stored nor restored on program change.
Live Mode, the 4 pages of 8, the numeric list, the dial and Store As naming all drive the OLED correctly (PAGE+ moved '1.1 Concert Grand' to '2.1 Vox Combo' and relabelled the eight slot buttons).
Nothing is persisted: after a full store/recall pass localStorage and sessionStorage both hold 0 keys, so no program survives a reload.

criteria.label: Performance controls & bindings
evidence: Sustain works and is not swallowed: with focus cleared, holding Space and releasing the key leaves rms 0.0607, and releasing Space drops it to 0.0040.

Web MIDI is real. With navigator.requestMIDIAccess stubbed, the app requested access once and attached one onmidimessage handler; feeding [144,60,100] rendered rms 0.0566 and lit one key, and [128,60,0] released it.

Master Level (100 -> 10 gives rms ratio 0.094), Piano layer level (0.105) and octave shift (specDist 11.6) all reach audio; velocity maps across roughly 4x (top of key rms 0.0489, bottom 0.0126) but is inverted - the top of the key is the loudest point.

The Pitch Stick and Modulation Wheel move and store presentation state but never reach audio (Pitch Stick 50 -> 100 specDist 2.50 against a 2.21 noise floor, rms ratio 0.979; Mod Wheel specDist 0.66), and neither is declared unsupported.

criteria.label: Cross-system workflows
evidence: Transpose and Panic behave: six TRANS+ presses shifted the rendered spectrum (specDist 15.4) and the OLED read '+6'; PANIC took a held note from rms 0.0793 to 0.0015 within 500 ms, faster than the natural release (0.0150 at the same offset).
Scenes reach audio: SCENE II enabled Piano B (aria-pressed true) and lifted rms from 0.0531 to 0.0943 (1.78x); SCENE I restored it.

Split routing is real but the piano is hard-wired to zone 1 with no zone selector in the Piano section. With Split on, the low point at C3 and Organ A assigned to zone 2, note 48 rendered rms 0.0507 while note 60 rendered exactly 0.000000 - the whole keyboard above the first split point is dead unless an organ or synth layer happens to be assigned there.
The crossfade selector (Off/±6/±12) only updates the OLED text; it has no audible or state effect beyond display.

criteria.label: Organ system
evidence: The inventory is there - nine drawbars with foot labels, LED ladders, four models, PERC/SOFT/FAST/3RD, KEY CLICK, a C1-C3/V1-V3 vibrato selector and rotary slow/fast/stop plus drive - but almost none of it reaches audio.

Nine drawbars set to 0 versus all set to 8: specDist 0.967, rms ratio 0.963 - inside the 2.21 measurement noise floor. The organ spec requires 'Nine drawbars with LED graphs driving the audible spectrum per model'.
Percussion on/off specDist 0.906, vibrato Off -> C3 specDist 0.941, rotary Fast with drive 100 specDist 0.987 - all inert.
The LED ladders are static art: they render a fixed 3/4/5/3/4/5/3/4/5 lit-segment pattern, unchanged after all nine drawbars were driven to 0.

criteria.label: Synth system
evidence: Three layers, the full 14-waveform list, LP12/LP24/HP/BP, LFO with five waveforms and three destinations, Poly/Mono/Legato, glide and an Off/Arp/Poly/Gate arpeggiator with rate, run and hold are all present in the panel and tracked in the synth OLED.

None of the synthesis controls reach audio: filter frequency 0 vs 100 specDist 1.39, resonance 0 vs 100 specDist 1.52, drive 0 vs 100 specDist 0.82, LFO Off vs Filter Freq at rate 100 specDist 0.73 - all below the 2.21 noise floor.
Envelope controls are absent entirely - no attack, decay, sustain or release control is rendered anywhere in the Synth section (the section landmark 'envelope controls' has no DOM node).

The arpeggiator does not run: over a 2.2 s held note the frame-by-frame rms coefficient of variation was 0.2047 with ARP RUN latched versus 0.2058 with it off, mean 0.1052 vs 0.1077 - no retriggering at all.

criteria.label: Layers, splits, scenes & morphs
evidence: Layers, splits, zones and scenes are all editable from the panel and two of the four reach audio: scenes (rms 0.0531 -> 0.0943) and split zone routing (note 48 rms 0.0507, note 60 rms 0.000000 with zones assigned).

Morph assignment is display-only. After arming WHEEL MORPH and pressing ASSIGN the destination label lit (.morph-lit present), but driving the wheel from 0 to 100 left the Synth filter frequency input still reading 72 and the rendered signal unchanged (specDist 2.36 against a 2.21 noise floor).
Layer routing is compromised: the organ and synth layers borrow the piano layer buses, so Organ A/B and Synth A/B/C are silent whenever the same-letter piano layer is off (rms 8.3e-5 and 6.1e-5).
The piano has no zone selector at all, so a 4-zone split can never place the piano anywhere but zone 1.

criteria.label: Programs & Live Mode
evidence: 32 slots as 4 pages of 8, the program dial, the numeric LIST 1-32 view, STORE, STORE AS with a name field, the dirty 'E' indicator, discard-on-change, 8 auto-storing Live slots, master clock tap plus BPM dial, transpose and Panic are all present and were exercised in the build.

Measured round trip: stored an edit to slot 1.4, moved to 1.1 and back, and got the stored values back with the OLED footer switching from 'Edited - change program discards edits' to 'Stored program'. LIVE MODE relabelled the eight buttons 'LIVE 1..8' and the OLED to 'LIVE 1'.

Factory content covers the engines as required: slots 3-6 recall organ programs (selecting 1.3 'B3 Club' set organ-layer-a aria-pressed true) and 7-8 recall synth programs (1.7 'Super Saw' set synth-layer-a true).
Gaps: nothing persists across a reload (localStorage 0 keys) and organ drawbar/percussion/vibrato/rotary state is outside the record, so the dirty flag stays clean after a drawbar edit.

criteria.label: Chassis, silhouette & geometry

measurements.label: Worst of the six section-fraction deviations

evidence: At 1440x900 the shell measures 1353.59 x 437.34 px: widthFraction 1353.59/1440 = 0.9400 (in [0.88,0.97]), aspectRatio 3.0950 vs 3.0951 specified.
.deck box height 236.16 px and .keybed 201.17 px over a 437.34 px shell give deckFraction 0.53998 and keybedFraction 0.45999 (targets 0.54/0.46).

Six panel widths measured across the deck extent (71.6 -> 1368.4 px): 0.1344/0.1920/0.0816/0.1200/0.2400/0.1920 vs spec 0.14/0.20/0.085/0.125/0.25/0.20; worst deviation 0.0056 (synth). Normalised to the sum of panel widths instead of the gapped extent the worst deviation is 0.00001 - the CSS grid is 14fr 20fr 8.5fr 12.5fr 25fr 20fr, exactly the spec fractions.
document.documentElement.scrollHeight = 900 at 1440x900: the instrument is fully visible without vertical scroll.

criteria.label: Hardware inventory & placement

measurements.label: Required section landmarks rendered in their own section
Controls a pointer can actually operate

evidence: Landmarks: 29 of 33 rendered in their own section. Missing - performance: rotary speaker controls (the spec note and reference/nord-stage-4-73.jpg put the rotary block on the exposed red chassis below Master Level; here rotary speed/drive sit inside the ORGAN plate and the ROTARY unit inside LAYER EFFECTS); piano: model selector (only a read-only .model-readout showing 'Salamander Grand'); program: three morph assign buttons (only WHEEL MORPH and PEDAL MORPH exist); synth: envelope controls (no attack/decay/release control anywhere).

Reachability measured with a 5x5 document.elementFromPoint grid over each control's bounding box at 1440x900, unscrolled, over all 122 button/input/select elements in the deck plus the sustain button: 120 resolved to themselves or a descendant at at least one grid point. The two unreachable ones are the 'Control pedal position' slider (covered by the overflowing Synth bank) and #effects-reverb-on (covered by an overflowing range input).

Forbidden: 1 occurrence - the LAYER EFFECTS section is a single undifferentiated control grid, seven structurally identical rows of button + select + slider (+ optional G) for Mod1, Mod2, Delay, Amp/EQ, Compressor, Reverb and Rotary, with no per-unit control complement.

The panels themselves overflow badly even where hit-testing still succeeds: the Organ LEVEL slider crosses into the PIANO plate, the drawbar thumbs hang ~70 px below the ORGAN panel over the keybed, and #master-level-decorative extends outside the overflow:hidden chassis box.

criteria.label: Keybed fidelity

measurements.label: Keys whose box falls inside the keybed

evidence: 73 keys, 43 white and 30 black, E1 to E7 - counted in the DOM at 1440x900 and matching the stage-4-73 variant exactly.
Black-key height 87.41 px against white-key height 143.30 px = 0.6100 (target 0.61).

Only 68 of 73 key boxes fall inside the keybed. The white keys carry their note-name text with the default min-width:auto, so they cannot shrink to fit: they measure 30.3-34.2 px each and total 1447.8 px inside a 1239.9 px .keys container, pushing the last five white keys (key-93, 95, 96, 98, 100) past the chassis right edge at x=1396.8 - the last one ends at x=1547.8, 151 px outside, and is clipped away by the shell's overflow:hidden.

Black keys are 28.52 px wide against 30.33 px for the first white key - a 0.940 width ratio where the hardware is near 0.55 - and they are positioned from a 100%/43 grid that no longer matches the overflowing white keys, so they drift out of alignment with the white-key boundaries across the keybed.

criteria.label: Chassis & plate colour fidelity
evidence: Sampled the rendered 1440x900 screenshot cropped to the instrument (593,052 px, 9,526 distinct colours) and took the nearest rendered colour to each reference by CIE76: chassisMid #851a25 dE 0.00, chassisDark #5f0e15 dE 1.87, panelBlueGray #3b424c dE 0.80, keyBlack #0b0b0b dE 0.00, keyWhite #dcdcda dE 1.04. 5/5 inside dE 12.
Restricting to colours covering at least 0.1% of the instrument area (i.e. real surfaces, not gradient sub-pixels) all five still match: worst dE 1.96 (chassisDark #5f0d15, 0.20% of area).

criteria.label: Materials, legends & displays
evidence: There is one knob cap in the entire instrument - the decorative Master Level knob (a single .knob-face element). Every other continuous control is a native <input type=range> with the browser's yellow/red accent-color thumb, and every discrete choice is a native <select> with an OS chevron: 25 select elements sit on the deck.

Silkscreen legends are set at clamp(3px,.28vw,5px) to clamp(3px,.55vw,8px), which resolves to 3-8 px at 1440x900 - the panel legends, the status line and the section titles are not legible at rendered size, and the PERFORMANCE status text is overprinted by the OCTAVE DOWN/UP buttons.
Drawbars are vertical range inputs whose red thumbs hang about 70 px below the ORGAN plate and lie across the top of the keybed; the Organ LEVEL slider runs out over the PIANO plate.

What is done well: the two OLEDs are convincing (teal-on-dark monospace with an inset glow and three text tiers), the 9x6 LED ladder is present, and the chassis gradient, top rail and inset plate borders read as the right materials.

criteria.label: Panel state & displays
evidence: Displays are live and mostly truthful: the program OLED read '1.1 Concert Grand / NO SPLIT · 120 BPM · 0 / Stored program' and updated through '1.4 Vox Combo · E / Edited - change program discards edits', 'OFF XFADE', '+6' transpose and 'LIVE 1'; the synth OLED tracked focus and waveform ('A: Super Saw' -> 'A: Square' -> 'B: FM 2-op (algorithm A)').

Control positions track their parameters for the piano: the Piano Type button and the model readout moved together to 'Upright'/'Felt Upright', and aria-pressed states follow the layer/scene/effect toggles.
The organ LED ladders do not follow anything: they render a fixed 3/4/5/3/4/5/3/4/5 lit pattern, identical after driving all nine drawbars to 0.

The Master Level knob face and the Master Level slider are two separate controls with independent values, so the knob does not move when the level changes; and the morph-lit indicator lights for an assignment that never reaches its destination.

criteria.label: Narrow-viewport retention
evidence: At 390x844 the shell is pinned to 1060 px wide inside a horizontally scrolling .product-study, with a fixed hint reading 'Scroll horizontally to inspect the complete Stage 4 73 surface'. Nothing collapses and nothing is destructively clipped.

But only a third of the instrument is reachable at a time: 3 of 6 deck sections (PERFORMANCE, ORGAN, PIANO) and 22 of 73 keys are within the 390 px viewport, and the deck's overflow defects (drawbar thumbs over the keybed, sliders crossing panel borders) are worse at this width.

issues.title: The instrument cannot play a chord - each note-on disconnects the sounding voices
issues.detail: play() calls configure() before every noteOn, and configure() rebuilds both layer racks, disconnecting the previous input/output gains that all sounding voices are wired into. Measured: holding C3+A3+C4 together, the 130.8 Hz bin reads -103.4 dB (vs -37.7 dB for C3 alone and -103.9 dB when C3 is not played) and only the last note survives; 8 keys held give rms 0.0564 / peak 0.185, identical to one note. It also leaks the discarded racks - 153 GainNodes, 34 ConvolverNodes and 34 StereoPannerNodes created after six notes.

issues.title: Organ and Synth are the piano voice under a different label
issues.detail: Both engines route their note events into the same createVoice() path, mapping organ models and synth waveforms onto the six piano oscillator profiles. Node census shows only 2 OscillatorNodes -> BiquadFilterNode -> GainNode per note whatever the engine. Sine vs Square measured specDist 1.55 and Square vs White Noise 2.27, both inside the 2.21 repeat-measurement floor; 'White Noise' renders a pitched tone. This is the Phase 3 hard gate 'not renamed copies of one oscillator'.

issues.title: Organ and Synth are silent unless the same-letter piano layer is enabled
issues.detail: Organ A and Synth A/C borrow piano layer bus A and Organ B / Synth B borrow bus B, but the bus output gain is driven by the PIANO layer's enabled flag. With Organ A on and Piano A off the rendered rms is 8.3e-5 (-61 dB relative to 0.093 with Piano A on); Synth A alone measures 6.1e-5. The organ and synth can never be played without the piano layered on top.

issues.title: The nine organ drawbars and all percussion/vibrato/rotary controls are inert
issues.detail: Setting all nine drawbars from 0 to 8 changes the rendered signal by specDist 0.967 (rms ratio 0.963), inside the 2.21 noise floor. Percussion on/off 0.906, vibrato Off->C3 0.941, rotary Fast + drive 100 0.987 - all inert. The organ spec requires 'Nine drawbars with LED graphs driving the audible spectrum per model'. The LED ladders are also static art, rendering a fixed 3/4/5 repeating pattern regardless of drawbar position.

issues.title: Every panel interaction closes the AudioContext and the next note is lost
issues.detail: The keyboard/MIDI effect depends on play(), which is recreated on every state change, so its cleanup runs audio.dispose() -> context.close() after any panel click. Instrumenting the constructor: 11 clicks produced 11 AudioContext constructions and 11 closes, and the context read state 'closed' between them. The first note after each interaction renders rms exactly 0.000000 over a 400 ms held key with currentTime still 0.0053 s.

issues.title: Rotary is not connected to the graph; Delay and Reverb on/off buttons are inert
issues.detail: 34 StereoPannerNodes were created and the connect census contains zero edges touching a StereoPannerNode, so the rotary unit has no path to the destination - toggling ROTARY gives specDist 0.751. Delay and Reverb are always in the chain with a parallel dry leg and only their internal coefficients change, so DELAY on/off measures specDist 1.038 and REVERB on/off 1.055, both below the 2.21 floor. Sibling types are also one node with different coefficients: mod2 Chorus vs Flanger specDist 0.516 and reverb Room vs Cathedral 1.233 are indistinguishable.

issues.title: Synth filter, LFO, arpeggiator reach nothing and envelope controls do not exist
issues.detail: Filter frequency 0 vs 100 specDist 1.39, resonance 1.52, drive 0.82, LFO Off vs Filter Freq at rate 100 0.73 - all inside the noise floor. With ARP RUN latched a 2.2 s held note showed rms coefficient of variation 0.2047 versus 0.2058 with the arp off: no retriggering. No attack/decay/release control is rendered anywhere in the Synth section, though the spec requires oscillator, filter and amplifier envelopes.

issues.title: Five white keys run off the chassis and the black keys are the wrong width and misaligned
issues.detail: The white keys carry their note-name text and default min-width:auto, so they measure 30.3-34.2 px each and total 1447.8 px inside a 1239.9 px container. Keys key-93, 95, 96, 98 and 100 extend past the chassis right edge at x=1396.8 (the last ends at 1547.8) and are clipped by overflow:hidden - 68/73 keys inside the keybed. The black keys are 28.52 px against a 30.33 px white key (0.940 ratio, hardware is near 0.55) and are laid out on a 100%/43 grid that no longer matches the overflowing whites, so they drift off the white-key boundaries.

issues.title: Deck controls overflow their panels across neighbouring sections and the keybed
issues.detail: The section grid is exact, but the contents are not contained: the Organ LEVEL slider crosses into the PIANO plate, the nine drawbar thumbs hang about 70 px below the ORGAN plate over the top of the keybed, the Program row sliders cross into SYNTH, and #master-level-decorative extends outside the chassis. Two controls are unreachable by the 5x5 elementFromPoint test as a direct result ('Control pedal position' and #effects-reverb-on). The candidate's own stage3-visual-audit.md reports none of this.

issues.title: Organ drawbar/percussion state is outside the program record and the dirty flag misses it
issues.detail: The program snapshot covers piano, effects, organ layers, synth, split, scenes, clock, transpose and morphs, but not organDrawbars or the percussion/key-click/vibrato/rotary state. Moving Organ drawbar 1 from 0 to 8 leaves the OLED reading 'Stored program' with no '· E', and those values are neither stored nor restored on program change - they leak across programs.

issues.title: Morph assignment never drives its destination
issues.detail: Arming WHEEL MORPH and pressing ASSIGN lights the destination label (.morph-lit), but moving the morph wheel from 0 to 100 left the Synth filter frequency input reading 72 and the rendered signal unchanged (specDist 2.36 against a 2.21 floor). Both morph sources are display-only.

issues.title: Turning Split on silences the keyboard above the first split point
issues.detail: The piano layers are hard-wired to zone 1 and the Piano section has no zone selector, so with Split on, the low point at C3 and Organ A in zone 2, note 48 rendered rms 0.0507 while note 60 rendered exactly 0.000000. The crossfade selector only changes the OLED text.

issues.title: Pitch stick and modulation wheel move but reach no audio and are not declared unsupported
issues.detail: Pitch Stick 50 -> 100 gives specDist 2.50 (noise floor 2.21) and rms ratio 0.979; Mod Wheel gives specDist 0.66. Both are stored as presentation state only, while the Piano section carries a PSTICK enable toggle implying the pitch stick works. Velocity is also inverted on the key face: the top of the key is loudest (rms 0.0489) and the bottom quietest (0.0126).

issues.title: The panel is built from native form controls at 3-8 px type
issues.detail: One knob cap exists in the whole instrument; 25 native <select> elements and dozens of native range inputs stand in for the hardware, and the LAYER EFFECTS section is seven structurally identical rows. Legends resolve to 3-8 px at 1440x900 and the PERFORMANCE status line is overprinted by the octave buttons.

issues.title: No state survives a reload
issues.detail: After a full store/recall pass localStorage and sessionStorage both hold 0 keys, so the 32 programs and 8 Live slots are session-only. Not a spec violation on its face, but it means the auto-storing Live slots lose their edits on refresh.
